Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.reconciliation

Class KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.in.reconciliation.KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.onchain-balance-sync.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService extends Object
Keeps observed_sats aligned with the blockchain for on-chain custody kinds.
  • KfeWalletKind.WATCH_ONLY — cold wallet: only chain balance is meaningful. Writes are gated by ChainProbeResult quality (Electrum mempool-aware preferred).
  • KfeWalletKind.CUSTODIAL_ONCHAIN — dual model: internal ledger (available/locked) authorizes spends; observed_sats mirrors chain for reconciliation/display.
  • KfeWalletKind.INTERNAL — not scanned (pooled / ledger-only).

    • syncWallet

      public long syncWallet(UUID walletId)
      Probes the chain and writes absolute observed_sats when the wallet kind permits it.

      Chain RPC runs outside a DB transaction; only the balance write uses TransactionTemplate (FOR UPDATE). Holding Hikari connections across scantxoutset starved the API and readiness probes.

      For KfeWalletKind.WATCH_ONLY, descriptor-only probes are quality ProbeQuality.CONFIRMED_UTXO_SET and will not overwrite a non-zero previous observed (cold live path owns Electrum parity).

      Parameters:
      walletId - wallet whose chain balance should be refreshed
      Returns:
      written satoshi balance, zero for unsupported kinds, or -1 when unavailable/failed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the wallet does not exist

    • applyObserved

      public long applyObserved(UUID walletId, long chainSats)
      Applies a legacy absolute amount as a confirmed-UTXO observation with a compatibility source label. For watch-only wallets this can seed an empty balance but cannot replace an existing nonzero live value. Prefer applyObserved(UUID, ChainProbeResult) when quality metadata is available.
      Parameters:
      walletId - wallet whose observed amount is updated
      chainSats - absolute confirmed balance in satoshis
      Returns:
      accepted or retained observed amount, or -1 for a negative input

    • applyObserved

      public long applyObserved(UUID walletId, ChainProbeResult probe)
      Writes an observed balance only when probe quality and previous observation permit replacement. Row locking and the quality decision occur inside one transaction; watch-only writes also zero spendable ledger buckets and publish dashboard state after commit.
      Parameters:
      walletId - wallet whose observed balance is being considered
      probe - chain amount, quality, authority flag, and source metadata
      Returns:
      accepted satoshi balance, previous balance when deferred, or -1 for invalid/unavailable input
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the wallet does not exist during transactional evaluation
